quests.title: Off the Boat
quests.description: Carry the boat's manifest from Bosun Grekka to Quartermaster Durn at Ashclaim Landing.

objectives.label: the boat's manifest, to Quartermaster Durn

quests.accept_text:
Can you take this up to Quartermaster Durn for me? I can't leave the jetty while there's a boat tied up.

It's the manifest for the boat you came in on. Durn won't open the stores until he's checked it against what was landed.

He's under the big awning with the barrels, just along the shore to the south-east. Tell him the count's right.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thanks. I'll check it myself, but it's good to have it.

If you're looking for work, ask around the landing. Most people here have more to do than hands to do it.

quests.title: Teeth on the Trunk Road
quests.description: Kill Greenbelt Raptors and Canopy Panthers in the Green Belt, east of Ashclaim Landing.
quests.accept_text:
Nobody could land on this island until the sea route opened three years ago. Now everything we land goes east along the trunk road through the Green Belt, and the road isn't safe.

The Greenbelt Raptors hunt it in packs. The Canopy Panthers wait in the trees above it and drop on whoever's at the back. I've lost porters to both.

The Green Belt is the jungle east of the landing. Follow the road in and kill what you find on it.
quests.turn_in_text:
The porters made it through this afternoon without seeing a raptor.

That'll let me send carts out again. Take this from the jetty stores.

quests.title: The Road to the Wharf
quests.description: Carry the jetty tally to Harbourmaster Skezz in Cinderwharf, on the north-east shore of the island.

objectives.label: the jetty tally, to Harbourmaster Skezz in Cinderwharf

quests.accept_text:
I need my tally taken to Harbourmaster Skezz in Cinderwharf, and you've shown you can look after yourself.

She runs the berths over there. Four barges left this jetty since spring and never reached her, and she wants my list of which ones.

Take the trunk road east through the Green Belt, then the east road north round the mountain into the Ashen Reach. Keep north along the shore until you reach the town gate. The country past the mountain is harder than this, so be ready for it.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's Grekka's tally. Thank you for bringing it all this way.

The same four barges are missing from my book. I'd like to find out what happened to them, and I could use your help.

quests.title: Crab for the Pot
quests.description: Collect Bargebreaker Claws from Bargebreaker Crabs in the Tempest Shallows, east of Ashclaim Landing.
quests.accept_text:
I've got forty people to feed and the supply boat brought me flour and salt.

There's plenty of food out in the shallows. The Bargebreaker Crabs are as big as a handcart and a claw will feed a table, but they fight.

Go east along the trunk road and take the strand road down to the water. Bring me the claws and I'll get them cooking.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are good claws. That's two nights of supper.

Sit down and have some once it's cooked. You can take this as well, somebody left it in the tent.

quests.title: Carried Up by Hand
quests.description: Kill Gate-Squatter Brawlers in the forecourt of Khaz Varun's Gate and take back the Ashclaim Supply Crates they stole.
quests.accept_text:
Somebody's been stealing crates off the ruin road at night, and I know who.

There are dwarves camped in the forecourt of Khaz Varun's Gate, south-east of here at the end of the road. They went into the city and came out wrong, and now they won't leave. The big ones, the Gate-Squatter Brawlers, come up the road after dark and take whatever my porters put down.

Get my crates back. You'll have to deal with the Brawlers to do it.
quests.turn_in_text:
These all have my tally numbers on them. Some of them haven't even been opened.

I don't understand what they wanted them for. Thank you for getting them back. Here's something from the stores.

quests.title: The Last in the Line
quests.description: Kill Mother Canopy, the great panther that hunts the trunk road in the Green Belt.
quests.accept_text:
I've lost three porters this month on the trunk road, and it was the last one in the line every time.

The woodcutters say it's a panther twice the size of the others. They call her Mother Canopy. She hunts the stretch of road under the thickest trees in the Green Belt, east of the landing.

She doesn't show herself to just anyone, but she'll come for someone who goes looking. Please kill her.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's her hide. I'm glad to see it.

I'll hang it over the stores so the porters can see she's gone. Choose something from what I've set aside for this.

quests.title: What It's Worth
quests.description: Visit the three places Surveyor Pim hasn't been able to cost: the heart of the Green Belt, the head of the strand road, and the western pass on the Scoured Slope.

objectives.label: the heart of the Green Belt
the head of the strand road
the western pass on the Scoured Slope

quests.accept_text:
I'm supposed to put a value on this whole island for the underwriters. Nobody could reach it before the change, so nobody's done it before.

There are three places I haven't been able to stand in. The first is the heart of the Green Belt, east of here along the trunk road. The second is further east, where the strand road meets the water. The third is the pass on the Scoured Slope, north-west of the landing up the west road.

Go to each one, have a good look, and come back and tell me what's there.
quests.turn_in_text:
Good timber in the Belt, wrecks at the strand, and ash and scorpions on the slope.

That's what I needed. I'll write it up and send it to my cousin Nix in Cinderwharf.

quests.title: Preachers in the Forecourt
quests.description: Kill Gate-Squatter Ashpreachers at Khaz Varun's Gate and collect their Ash-Prayer Tablets.
quests.accept_text:
I can't survey the forecourt of Khaz Varun's Gate because the squatters keep setting fire to my equipment.

The ones doing it are the Gate-Squatter Ashpreachers. They stand in the rubble shouting at the arch, and they throw fire at strangers. They also carry slates with writing on them. If it's a claim on the city, the underwriters need to know.

The forecourt is south-east of here at the end of the ruin road. Deal with the Ashpreachers and bring me some of their slates.
quests.turn_in_text:
They all say the same thing, over and over: "the forge is lit and we were not called."

It isn't a claim. I don't know what it means. I'll send these to the Deedkeeper in Cinderwharf, she reads the old script better than I do.

quests.title: What the Gorillas Know
quests.description: Collect Chewed Bitterbark from Ashfur Gorillas in the Green Belt for Dr. Mwangi.
quests.accept_text:
I've run out of painkillers, and the boat won't bring more for a month.

Before I came through I had a whole cabinet of them. Here I've got bandages and clean water. The woodcutters tell me the Ashfur Gorillas in the Green Belt chew a grey bark and put it on their burns, and the burned ones are climbing again in a day.

The Green Belt is east of the landing along the trunk road. The gorillas carry the chewed bark with them. I'd like to try it.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is strong. Even a little of it numbs your mouth.

I think I can make a proper painkiller out of it. Thank you, that's going to help a lot of people here.

quests.title: A Dressing That Keeps
quests.description: Collect Snapper Fat from Shallows Snappers in the Tempest Shallows for Dr. Mwangi's burn dressings.
quests.accept_text:
Most of what I treat here is burns. Before I came through I'd have ordered dressings from the hospital stores, but here I've got to make them, and I need a clean fat that keeps.

Butter goes off in a day in this heat and lamp oil makes a wound worse. The cook says the fat under a Shallows Snapper's shell stays fresh for weeks.

The snappers are out in the Tempest Shallows, east along the trunk road and down the strand road. Watch their beaks.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's good clean fat.

I'll mix it with the bark and see if it holds. If it works I'll have proper burn dressings again. Thank you.

quests.title: Hulls and Ribs
quests.description: Take Seasoned Wreck Timber from the Wreckpicker Murlocs in the Tempest Shallows.
quests.accept_text:
I built boats in Booty Bay until the sea route opened three years ago and the Ashclaim offered me more. I need seasoned timber for barge hulls, and the jungle wood is too green. It warps before the pitch has dried, and I can't use it.

The best timber on the island is in the old wrecks out in the Tempest Shallows, but the Wreckpicker Murlocs strip the wrecks and carry the planks off to build with.

Go east along the trunk road and down the strand road to the water, and take the timber off the murlocs.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is old oak that's been under salt water for years. It's harder than new wood.

I can frame a hull with this. There's still something sinking my barges, though, and I want to talk to you about it.

quests.title: The Barge-Eater
quests.description: Kill The Barge-Eater in the Tempest Shallows.
quests.accept_text:
I've found out what's been sinking my barges.

One of my crew watched it from the beach. A loaded barge was crossing the bay and a huge crab came up under it and put a claw through the hull. The jetty hands call it The Barge-Eater.

It lives in the deep part of the Tempest Shallows, south-east of here past the last of the wrecks. It comes up for people who go out hunting it. Please kill it before I lose another crew.
quests.turn_in_text:
My crew saw you bring the claw up the beach.

We can launch again now. I'm going to mount the claw on the next hull. Take this, and thank you.

quests.title: Clear the Slip
quests.description: Kill Shallows Snappers and Bargebreaker Crabs along the barge channel in the Tempest Shallows.
quests.accept_text:
My barges need a clear channel out of the bay, and the bottom's crawling with things that slow them down.

The Shallows Snappers bite at the steering oars and the Bargebreaker Crabs grab hold of the hulls. A slow barge is an easy target for worse.

The channel runs out through the Tempest Shallows, east along the trunk road and down the strand road. Wade out and clear what you find.
quests.turn_in_text:
The pilot took a barge out on the evening tide and nothing touched the oar.

Thank you. Here's something from the saw pit stores.

quests.title: The Unhoused
quests.description: Kill Borrik the Unhoused, who leads the squatters at Khaz Varun's Gate.
quests.accept_text:
The squatters in the forecourt follow one of their own, and I knew him before he went in.

His name's Borrik. He was a mason, and the Thane sent him down with the first party. He came out after six days and wouldn't go further than the forecourt. He says the city turned him away, and the others call him Borrik the Unhoused.

He keeps to the broken ground south and east of here. He'll come out for someone who's hunting him. I can't leave my post, and I don't think I could do it anyway.
quests.turn_in_text:
So he's gone.

He built half the hold in Cinderwharf before he went down there. The other squatters might go home now that he's not leading them. Take this, and thank you.

quests.title: Whelps in the Vents
quests.description: Kill Ashwing Whelps on the Scoured Slope, where the old city's vents come out.
quests.accept_text:
Khaz Varun gets its air through shafts that come out high on the mountain, and something's nesting in them.

My family kept those vents clear for nine generations. Now the Ashwing Whelps roost in the shaft mouths because the stone's warm, and they've filled them with ash and bones.

The vents open onto the Scoured Slope, north of here up the west road. Clear out the whelps for me.
quests.turn_in_text:
I felt the air at the arch change about an hour ago. It's blowing out again, the way it should.

Thank you. Take this with my family's thanks.

quests.title: Nine Generations
quests.description: Hear Gatewatch Bron out, then carry his count book to Thane Durgan Ashhold in Cinderwharf.

objectives.label: Bron's count book, to Thane Durgan Ashhold in Cinderwharf

quests.accept_text:
You keep looking at that arch. Ask me about it before you do anything about it.

When you're done, I've got a favour to ask. I keep a book of everyone who goes through the gate and everyone who comes back. The Thane hasn't seen it in two months because nobody will carry it to him.

He's in Cinderwharf on the north-east shore. Take the trunk road east, the east road north round the mountain, and follow the shore north to the town.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is Bron's book.

Forty-one have gone in since spring and twenty-six have come out. He's marked nine of those as not right. I signed the orders that sent most of them.

I need someone who'll go down there anyway. If that's you, I've got work for you.

quests.title: Prospecting by Gizzard
quests.description: Collect Basilisk Gizzard Stones from Rubble Basilisks around Khaz Varun's Gate.
quests.accept_text:
Nobody's prospected this island since the gate opened three years ago, and I want to find the truesilver without digging up half of it.

Basilisks swallow stones to grind their food, and they pick them up wherever they walk. If there's truesilver in a basilisk's gizzard, there's a seam somewhere on its route.

The Rubble Basilisks are thickest round Khaz Varun's Gate, south-west of here. Bring me the stones from their gizzards.
quests.turn_in_text:
Look at the silver in that one.

Most of these have truesilver in them, so there's a seam near the gate. I'll go looking for it. Take your share of this.

quests.description: Look at the two outcrops on the Scoured Slope and kill the Cinderslope Flame Spirits that gather round them.

objectives.label: the western outcrop on the Scoured Slope
the eastern outcrop on the Scoured Slope

quests.accept_text:
Truesilver usually shows in a blue-grey rock, and I can see two patches of that colour from here.

Both are up on the Scoured Slope. One's north-west, above the west road, and the other's north-east, above the east road. The Cinderslope Flame Spirits gather on that kind of rock and I can't get close.

Go up to both outcrops and take a good look. You'll have to deal with the Flame Spirits first.
quests.turn_in_text:
The western one is the real thing and the eastern one is just weathered slag.

That saves me a lot of climbing. I'll stake the western outcrop tomorrow. Take this, it came out of the first seam I found here.

quests.title: What Grows Back First
quests.description: Kill Ashscree Scorpions on the Scoured Slope, where the first plants are coming back.
quests.accept_text:
I'm studying a strip of the Scoured Slope where plants are growing back on the bare ash.

I did the same work in the hills near Quito before the change, after the eruptions there. Here the first thing to grow back is a small red fern. The Ashscree Scorpions burrow under it and tear the roots up.

The slope is north of here, where the trees stop. If you can thin out the scorpions I'll be able to finish my notes for the season.
quests.turn_in_text:
The ferns on the lower plot are still standing. Thank you.

I'll be able to keep watching that plot through the season now. The Ashclaim will get a copy of my notes.

quests.description: Carry Teodora's specimen press to Alchemist Pell in Cinderwharf.

objectives.label: the specimen press, to Alchemist Pell in Cinderwharf

quests.accept_text:
The Ashclaim pays me to tell them which plants here are worth money, and I've pressed forty of them between these boards.

Alchemist Pell in Cinderwharf decides what the Ashclaim buys, so the press needs to reach him flat and dry.

Take the east road north round the mountain into the Ashen Reach and follow the shore north to the town. He's by the salvage yard. Please ask him to send the boards back, it's the only press I've got.
quests.turn_in_text:
She's labelled every one of these properly. I was expecting a sack of leaves.

I can sell three of these straight away, and the red fern could be worth a lot. Tell her she'll have her boards back, and that I'm asking the Ashclaim to raise her pay.

quests.description: Wade out to the near wreck in the Tempest Shallows and get Jex's boots back from the Bargebreaker Crabs.

objectives.label: the near wreck in the Tempest Shallows

quests.accept_text:
I went out to the near wreck in my good sea boots and came back without them.

It's the wreck you can see sticking up to the south-east. A Bargebreaker Crab got one boot and another one got the second while I was getting away.

They were made for me in Booty Bay and they've got brass toes. The crabs round that wreck will still have them. Please get them back for me.
quests.turn_in_text:
Those are mine. They're chewed, but they'll do.

Thank you. Here, this came out of the wreck before the crabs chased me off.

quests.description: Search the two far wrecks in the Tempest Shallows and take the Sealed Cargo Casks the Wreckpicker Murlocs have carried off.

objectives.label: the eastern wreck in the Tempest Shallows
the southern wreck in the Tempest Shallows

quests.accept_text:
There are two big wrecks a long way out that still had cargo when they went down.

One is south-east of here at the edge of the deep water. The other is further south, past the sandbar. The cargo was sealed in small casks, and the Wreckpicker Murlocs have been carrying them off.

Go out to both wrecks and see what's left, and get the casks back from the murlocs. We'll split whatever's inside.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's lamp oil, and it's still good after all that time under water.

Trader Gex in Cinderwharf will pay well for it. Take your half of the money, and I'll keep the casks.

quests.description: A Gate-Squatter was wearing an Ashclaim pay chit. Take it to Quartermaster Durn at Ashclaim Landing.

quests.accept_text:
The Brawler had a brass tag on a string round its neck. It's a pay chit from the Ashclaim stores, the kind every porter at the landing gets, and it's stamped with a number.

Quartermaster Durn at Ashclaim Landing keeps the pay book. He'll know whose number it is.
quests.turn_in_text:
I know this number. It belonged to Hedda, one of my porters.

She went to look at the gate on her rest day, because her grandmother was born in the city. I thought she'd gone home on the boat. I'll correct the book. Thank you for bringing this back.

quests.accept_text:
The murloc was carrying a hardbound book. The pages are swollen with sea water but the ink can still be read. It's written in English, and the dates are from three years ago.

The dwarves and goblins won't be able to read it. Dr. Mwangi at Ashclaim Landing came through from Earth, so she probably can.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is the log of the MV Amani, a coastal freighter out of Dar es Salaam. I used to see her come into Mombasa.

The last entry is from the day everything changed. The mate wrote that the coast had disappeared and they were heading for the only land they could see. That must have been this island.

quests.description: Find the steel wreck in the far Tempest Shallows and recover the crew's discharge books from the Wreckpicker Murlocs.

objectives.label: the steel wreck in the far Tempest Shallows

quests.accept_text:
The log only lists the crew by rank. I'd like to know their names.

Every seaman carries a discharge book with his name and photograph in it. The murlocs took the log, so they've probably taken those as well.

The log puts the ship aground at the far south-east corner of the Tempest Shallows. She'll be the only steel wreck out there. See if she's there, and bring back any of the books you can find. These people have been missing for three years.
quests.turn_in_text:
I can read every name in these.

This one is Juma Otieno, the second engineer, from Kisumu. I don't know if any of them got ashore. I'll copy the names out and send them with every boat that leaves, in case somebody has met them.

quests.description: Enter Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow, and kill Gatewarden Hrun in the Gatehouse Hall.
quests.accept_text:
The first thing standing between us and the city is my great-grandfather's gatewarden.

His name was Hrun. He was holding the gate of Khaz Varun the night the city went dark, and he's still holding it. The gate opened by itself three years ago, on the day the world changed, and nobody I've sent in since has got past him.

The gate is on the south shore, a short walk south-east of Ashclaim Landing. Hrun is in the Gatehouse Hall past the Ember Road. He was a loyal dwarf, so make it quick.
quests.turn_in_text:
So Hrun can rest now.

I'll have his name added at the shrine tonight. The gatehouse was only the first part. The worst of it's deeper in.

quests.description: Kill Forge-Lord Darrok at the Great Forge in Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow.
quests.accept_text:
The squatters at the gate say the forge is lit, and they're right.

The Great Forge of Khaz Varun has been cold since before my father was born, and now it's burning. The rolls say the last Forge-Lord was a dwarf named Darrok who never left his anvil.

The Great Forge is on the east side of the city, past the Counting Hall. Whatever is working that anvil, I want it stopped before it's finished.
quests.turn_in_text:
So Forge-Lord Darrok was still there.

The Underwriter will be glad the forge works. I'm less glad about what was being made in it. That leaves the hall itself, and the one who's in it.

quests.description: Kill Thane Morrun the Unmade in the Hall of Ashhold, at the top of Khaz Varun.
quests.accept_text:
My great-grandfather was Morrun Ashhold, and he's still sitting in his chair at the top of the city.

One of the first party got as far as the Hall of Ashhold and saw him through the doors. He hasn't been a living dwarf for a long time. The squatters call him the Unmade.

I can't take the city back while he's sitting in that chair. The hall is at the north end of the city, past the Shadow Gallery. I'm asking you to kill Thane Morrun the Unmade.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's done, then.

I've waited most of my life to hear that. Morn will light a flame for him tonight and I'll be there when he does. Take this, with the thanks of the Ashclaim.

quests.accept_text:
I keep one flame on this terrace for everyone still down in the city, because I don't know their names.

Every Dark Iron of Khaz Varun carried a name-tablet, a small piece of iron with their name punched into it. The Ash-Wretches in the lower city were our people once, and some will still have their tablets.

The gate is on the south shore, south-east of Ashclaim Landing. The Ash-Wretches are in the Ash Pits and the Deep Way in the middle of the city. Bring me the tablets and I'll give each of them a flame.
quests.turn_in_text:
I'll read every one of these names tonight.

Two of them are Ashholds and one is an Emberhold, so I'll tell Bron at the gate. I'll look the rest up in the Deedkeeper's rolls. Thank you.

quests.accept_text:
There are dwarves in the city with iron masks riveted over their faces, and they weren't there before.

Some of them are wearing Ashclaim boots. Something in the Cells is taking the people who go in, masking them, and sending them out to preach. Those who've seen it call it The Iron Mask.

The Cells are on the west side of the city, below the Deep Way. Please stop it before it takes anyone else.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you. Nobody else will be masked now.

I can't help the ones already wearing them, but I'll say the rites for them anyway. Take this from the shrine. It should go to someone who's been down there.

quests.description: Inspect the Smelter and the Great Forge in Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow, and kill Smelter-Master Vaud.

objectives.label: the Great Forge in Khaz Varun

quests.accept_text:
I've put money into a foundry I've never seen, and my partners want to know what state it's in.

The Thane says the works in Khaz Varun are sound. I'd like to hear that from someone who's actually stood in them.

The Smelter and the Great Forge are both on the east side of the city. The gate is on the south shore near Ashclaim Landing. Look them over for me. The Smelter still has its old master, Smelter-Master Vaud, and you'll need to get rid of him first.
quests.turn_in_text:
The crucibles are whole, the flues draw, and the Great Forge is hot.

That's better than I'd hoped. I'll tell my partners the works can be used. Here's your payment.

quests.description: Collect Zealot's Iron Masks from the Masked Zealots in Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow.
quests.accept_text:
I've got a buyer on the mainland who collects Dark Iron work, and he wants the iron masks.

The Masked Zealots in Khaz Varun wear them riveted shut, and there's nothing else like them. I'd rather the Keeper didn't hear where they went.

The Zealots are all through the city from the Gatehouse Hall inward. The gate is on the south shore near Ashclaim Landing. I'll pay well for every mask.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are real. The rivets are still tight.

They're heavier than they look. I'll send them to the buyer and I won't be asking for more. Here's your money.

quests.description: Recover the Stonecast Breastplate from The Crusher in the Workshop of Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow.
quests.accept_text:
My grandmother was the best armoursmith in Khaz Varun, and I've never seen any of her work.

She got out as a girl with nothing but her hammer. One of the Thane's people says there's a machine in the Workshop called The Crusher, plated with armour taken off the walls, and that one of the plates carries the Stonecast mark.

The Workshop is on the west side of the city, just past the Ember Road. I'd like that breastplate.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's her mark under the arm.

I can see how she shaped the edge, and it's not how I was taught. I'm going to spend tonight at the forge working it out. Take this, and thank you.

quests.description: Search the Counting Hall of Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow, and take the Roll of Oaths from Overseer Grall.

objectives.label: the Counting Hall in Khaz Varun

quests.accept_text:
The Thane's claim rests on the rolls I keep, and one of them is missing.

When the city went dark, the Deedkeeper of the day carried out the records of births and debts. He had to leave the Roll of Oaths, because it was chained to a desk in the Counting Hall. Without it I can't prove which families swore to the Ashholds.

The Counting Hall is in the middle of the city, past the Gatehouse Hall. I'm told Overseer Grall still walks his rounds with the roll on his belt.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's all here, every leaf.

Every family on this wharf swore to the Ashholds, and now I can show it. I'll take this to the Underwriter tomorrow. Thank you.

quests.description: Collect Pouches of Black Dust from the Crazed Miners in Khaz Varun, the Black Hollow.
quests.accept_text:
People go into that city sane and come out raving, and I want to know if it's something in the air.

If it is, it matters to everyone here, because we're shipping ore out of the same rock. The Crazed Miners in the lower workings have been breathing it longest, and their clothes will be full of it.

The gate is on the south shore near Ashclaim Landing. The miners are in the Ember Road and the Borer Workings. Bring me the dust, and cover your mouth while you collect it.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's mostly forge soot, but there's a fine red grit in it that glows when I breathe on it. It isn't in the ore we ship.

So it's coming from something burning down there now. I'll write to the doctor at the landing tonight.
